content.caption: 明明只是想優雅地午睡，為什麼這塊沾滿麵粉的桌布非要跟我玩捉迷藏呢？
content.scene: In a sunlit kitchen, 小雪, a white long-haired cat with striking blue eyes, sits atop a wooden table. She maintains a regal, upright posture despite being partially draped in a messy, flour-dusted tablecloth. Her pink nose is twitching slightly as she stares with dignified disapproval at a spilled bowl of dough nearby. Hand-painted book illustration style with soft, natural light.
content.topic: Graceful appearance versus ordinary household chaos
